linkedin.about:
Jamie Kern Lima went from Denny’s waitress to billion-dollar entrepreneur! She’s the host of the #1 Self-Improvement Podcast in the country, The Jamie Kern Lima Show podcast, where Oprah Winfrey was her first guest. She’s a Guest Shark on the upcoming Season 16 of Shark Tank on ABC. She’s a two-time New York Times bestselling author, her new book WORTHY made it 14 weeks in a row on the NY Times bestseller list. She’s founder of IT Cosmetics, a company she started in her living room and sold to L'Oréal in a billion-dollar deal, becoming the first female CEO of a brand in L’Oreal’s 100+ year history. Her love of her customers and remarkable authenticity and belief eventually landed her on the Forbes America's Richest Self-Made Women list. 

 

She's been a Denny's waitress, a struggling entrepreneur, and has overcome years of self-doubt, body-doubt and God-doubt. She's a mother of two and an active investor, speaker, and thought leader who is passionate about inspiring and elevating women. She recently held her live event called Becoming Unstoppable, where more than 260,000 women joined live from their living rooms, and many iconic women of our time including Oprah Winfrey, Ellen DeGeneres, Robin Roberts and Maria Shriver all joined to support Jamie in her mission of building self-worth in every single girl, woman and person! She's also an active philanthropist who has funded leadership training in more than 100 prisons and shelters across the US, and has donated over $40 million in product and funds to help women face the effects of cancer with confidence. She's donating 100% of her author proceeds for WORTHY.

Wow!!!!🤯😭❤️ I’m so grateful to be named on the  @forbes 250 Greatest Self-Made Americans! Especially since it’s not based only on achievement alone, but on where you started and how far you’ve come. Only in America can I go from waitressing tables (my Dennys uniform in the last photo 🥰) to launching a business with close to zero money in my living room, working hard for years and eventually building a company from that very living room that now impacts millions of people. The American Dream is possible, I’m living proof of it, i believe in it and I’m so honored to do everything I can to help others achieve it for themselves too! It’s one of the greatest things about our country! ✨❤️🇺🇸 

And while I am honored to be on the 250 Greatest Self-Made Americans list, I also know I’m only partly self-made, and mostly God-made. Yes I worked hard, got back up every time I got knocked down, and kept going despite so many NOs and rejected. But He did all the rest! The open doors, the closed doors, the Divine connections, the grace beyond comprehension!!!

Success leaves clues and learning from these incredible women and their insights. Wisdom, ups, downs, stories and raw, real vulnerability and courage has truly been the greatest gift! 💝 And thank YOU to each of you for joining me weekly, sharing the Jamie Kern Lima Show podcast with everyone you know and for growing this show together!!!! 🙏✨💫

What’s your favorite episode/guest on The JKL Show podcast so far?  And, what guest would you like to see/suggest next on the show?  Let me know in the comments below (it can be you too!)  I’ll read every one!  😍

WHAT IF YOU STOPPED WAITING TO FEEL READY…AND STARTED BETTING ON YOURSELF? ❤️✨

BRAND NEW EPISODE OUT NOW! 🎉 Design icon and entrepreneur @‌amberinteriors is on The Jamie Kern Lima Show, and what she shares about building confidence is SO powerful! 🙌

Amber didn’t have formal training. She didn’t always know what she was doing. And she says she definitely didn’t get everything right. But instead of waiting until she felt “qualified,” she trusted her intuition, took the next step, learned from what worked AND what didn’t - and kept going bigger. 🔥

One of my favorite lessons from this conversation: 

Confidence isn’t something you have to FIND before you begin. Sometimes confidence is something you BUILD by beginning. ❤️

Bet on yourself. Reinvest in yourself. Hire help where you need it. Learn from the failures. And KEEP GOING! 🙌✨

Is your child your life’s greatest purpose? There are some kinds of love you simply can’t put into words❤️

BRAND NEW EPISODE OUT NOW! ✨ Superstar designer and inspiring entrepreneur @‌amberinteriors opens up on The Jamie Kern Lima Show podcast about the person she calls the light of her life - her daughter, Gwyneth. ❤️

Amber shares that growing up, she didn’t always know what she was meant to do or even whether motherhood would be part of her story. But when Gwyneth came into her life, everything changed.

“My purpose was never more clear than after I had her.”
Beyond the business, the success, the beautiful homes and everything she’s built, Amber says her greatest purpose is watching her daughter become the person she is meant to be. 🥹❤️

And when asked what she hopes Gwyneth will say about her 50 years from now, Amber’s emotional answer brought her to tears. 😭❤️

This is SUCH a beautiful moment between two moms about motherhood, purpose, love and what really matters in the end. 🙏✨

“We’re all carrying things no one can see.” ❤️🙏

BRAND NEW EPISODE OUT NOW. ✨ Iconic designer and inspiring entrepreneur @amberinteriors opens up on The Jamie Kern Lima Show podcast about one of the most personal parts of her story - being diagnosed with multiple sclerosis.

In 2020, Amber began losing feeling in her feet. It moved up to her knees and eventually her hips, but she kept going for nearly a week because she was so accustomed to putting everything and everyone else FIRST. ❤️‍🩹

Then came the diagnosis that changed everything.

Amber shares what it’s really like living with an invisible disease, the struggle of appearing “fine” when you don’t feel fine, and the unexpected perspective shift that came when life forced her to pause. 🙏❤️

“I was on such a mission to grow…big, big, big, next, next, next. And all of a sudden, you get sick and everything stops.”

This is such a vulnerable and powerful part of Amber’s story - and a beautiful reminder that we never truly know what someone else may be carrying. ❤️✨
